title: Czar Vargo's demand
summary: The Etherite conqueror's failed ultimatum to the nations.

claims.text: Vargo's fleet demanded that every national government hand over its arsenal; only a desperate Technocratic attack with steam robots and mutant soldiers drove the airships off past the Horizon.
The New World Order wiped the attempt from the record, and Void Engineers have since reported sighting the fleet in the Deep Umbra.

title: Najjda Bantu
summary: An African Chorus archmage who sits on the Primi Council.

claims.text: Najjda left the Council during the slave trade, later helped found the Underground Railroad and fought the Confederacy, then went home to drive out European settlers.
After the Ahl-i-Batin left the Council, allies brought Najjda back to Horizon; over 300 years old, Najjda names the One as a goddess, Bau-Hatt, and can take animal forms.

title: Raging Eagle
summary: An Akashic master of the Scales of the Dragon who remembers many lives.

claims.text: Raging Eagle's past lives reach back to the Himalayan War; in this life the master trained in Colorado in the most destructive arts of Do.
Raging Eagle believes death will come in any fight lasting more than a week, and is prone to deep Quiets and sudden moods.

title: Sam Haine
summary: The Verbena wanderer called the Changing Man.

claims.text: No one knows this Verbena's true name; Sam Haine is a pun on Samhain, and the Changing Man's face is never the same.
Sam Haine gathers mythic pieces of reality for safekeeping in Verbena Horizon Realms and loves to debunk the false occult lore the Syndicate spreads.

title: Secret Agent John Courage
summary: A Man in Black who fights everyone and keeps escaping.

claims.text: Courage tops the Technocracy's hit list, yet many rank-and-file agents admire Courage and let the agent slip away.
No one knows why Courage does what Courage does, only that wherever trouble starts, Courage is close by.
Jodi Blake rarely looks the same twice and is said to be a barabbi from a Tradition; even other Nephandi distrust Jodi.
More than forty mages are said to have fallen through Jodi's manipulation.

title: The Seattle Chantry under Pike Place
summary: A Tradition Chantry hidden beneath Seattle's market.

claims.text: A Chantry lies hidden under Pike Place Market, while the Technocracy has deeply infiltrated Seattle, above all through a local aircraft maker.
Its members stay loyal to the founder, Rudolfo Ouspensky, though rivalries are growing.
The way in is a shabby curio shop deep in the market called the Conjurer's Cubbyhole, marked by a garish poster of Rudolfo, King of Magic.
